name: 91722 · Covina, CA
findings: ZIP 91722 (Covina) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91722 (Covina) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91722 (Covina) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
